datasets.name: Landslide vector dataset of Asakura-shi and Hita-shi
datasets.verbatim: A vector dataset of the study area delineating landslide areas along with damaged roads and flooded areas, was obtained from the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) [24]

datasets.name: Himawari-8 AHI apparent reflectance data
datasets.source: Center for Environmental Remote Sensing (CERES) at Chiba University, Japan
datasets.verbatim: Himawari-8 AHI precisely geolocated apparent reflectance data covering Japan (N 50◦–N 20◦ and E 120◦–E 150◦) were obtained for a period of 1 January 2016 to 31 December 2017 from the Center for Environmental Remote Sensing (CERES) at Chiba University, Japan (http://www.cr.chiba-u.jp/databases/GEO/H8_9/FD/index.html).

datasets.name: Landslide and debris-mud flow polygon dataset (Hiroshima)
datasets.verbatim: A vector dataset of landslides and debris-mud flows delineated based on visual interpretations of aerial photos acquired by GSI after the rain event [46] was obtained and used as a reference

methods.name: NDVI-based landslide detection using Himawari-8 AHI
methods.summary: The method uses Himawari-8 AHI NDVI time series data to detect landslides by identifying abrupt decreases in NDVI values following a rain event. It involves filtering and smoothing the AHI 10-minute resolution data, calculating the NDVI difference (∆NDVI) between pre- and post-event periods, and correlating this difference with the percentage of landslide area.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we investigated the utility of Himawari-8 AHI data for mapping the spatial extent of landslide-affected areas caused by a torrential rain event... To quantify the NDVI change due to landslides, NDVI difference (∆NDVI) was computed by subtracting post-event smoothed NDVI values from pre-event smoothed NDVI values on a per pixel basis.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are referenced but lack direct links or are not publicly accessible, and the custom code used for the NDVI-based landslide detection method is not provided.
